title: AI-Driven Predictive Beamforming for Climate-Resilient 5G/6G Networks
summary: Addis Ababa Science and Technology University proposes AI-driven predictive beamforming for 5G and 6G links in bad weather, with simulation and an open-source toolkit still planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The research design combines weather prediction and reinforcement learning to adapt high-frequency communication links. The intended benefit is more reliable connections during adverse weather. In the 2025 entry, the author plans simulation, data development and reproducible tools. The author plans an ns-3 simulation with synthetic rain impairments and states that all code will be released on GitHub under an MIT license. No source reports a simulated or measured improvement in link reliability. The author's submissions to the ITU interim report of 2026 cover other topics and give no result for this project.
